meta.title: An uninvited vendor cannot read the event
gaps: it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown
warnings: act 1: QA vendor 2 is not invited in this setup — it acts as an uninvited vendor

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: A second QA vendor sends the request that reads the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not authorized to perform this action”, and never with a server error.
